children.name: Perception and VLM reuse
children.description: Token reduction and temporal reuse of perception-language computation.
children.description_zh: 视觉 token 压缩、感知语言计算的时间复用与按需刷新。

children.name: One-step generation and distillation
children.description: Training objectives and schedules for fewer action-expert evaluations.
children.description_zh: 通过训练目标与噪声调度减少 Action Expert 调用次数。

children.name: History sources and warm starts
children.description: Use historical actions or visual states to construct generation sources.
children.description_zh: 利用历史动作或视觉状态构造生成起点，而非仅拼接历史条件。

children.name: Adaptive sampling budgets
children.description: Adapt stochasticity and solver steps to the current conditional action distribution.
children.description_zh: 根据条件动作分布调节随机性与采样步数。

children.name: Asynchronous execution and delay compensation
children.description: Overlap inference and execution; maintain temporal alignment and chunk continuity.
children.description_zh: 重叠推理与执行，处理观测过时、动作块衔接与时间对齐。

children.name: Execution timing and granularity
children.description: Task execution efficiency is tracked separately from model inference latency.
children.description_zh: 记录任务执行效率，并与模型推理延迟分别比较。

children.name: WAM and policy foundations
children.description: Architectural context and WAM visual-generation costs; not a count of dedicated VLA accelerators.
children.description_zh: 记录策略架构与 WAM 视觉生成成本；不把所有基座算成专门的 VLA 加速方法。
